facets.description: utilities.js:182–183 hardcodes the client size check to 10MB for non-images, ignoring max_attachment_size_kb and incorrectly accepting or rejecting attachments.
utilities.js:184 reports 10MB in the file_too_large message instead of the configured attachment limit.
utilities.js:246–247 reports 10MB in the 413 handler's file_too_large message instead of the actual limit.
